question: Which virtues and which sixteenfold group are located in the person principle down to earth?
premises: Service, purity, contentment, and straightness complete the ten declared qualities.
These qualities belong in the person principle.
A sixteenfold group is situated there extending down to earth.
inference: The person principle contains the completed set of ten virtues and a sixteenfold group reaching to the earth level.
uncertainties: The exact members of the sixteenfold group are not named in this verse.
plain_english: Service, purity, contentment, and straightness complete the ten declared qualities in the person principle. Again, a sixteenfold group is situated there, extending down to earth.
